## Plan your visit

Opening hours

Monday **Closed**  
Tuesday **10–20**  
Wednesday **10–18**  
Thursday **10–18**  
Friday **10–20**  
Saturday **10–18**  
Sunday **10–18**

Tickets

Regular: **170 SEK**  
Reduced: **140 SEK**  
Group discount (15 people): **140 SEK**  
It is cheaper to buy a ticket online. Free admission for those 18 and under and Klubb Moderna. [Free Friday 18–20](https://www.modernamuseet.se/en/stockholm/events/free-friday-18-00-20-00/).

[Tickets & membership](https://www.modernamuseet.se/en/stockholm/tickets-and-memberships/)

Find us

Skeppsholmen, Stockholm  
Main entrance: Exercisplan 4

[Find us](https://www.modernamuseet.se/en/stockholm/visit-the-museum/plan-your-visit/find-us/)
